notes: Manuscript page 103 is written at the lower left. The upright sheet contains an opening line and two displayed formulas, prose with several corrections, a substantial diagonal marginal note, and a final prose paragraph. There is no date, title, independent drawing or geometric diagram on this sheet. Long curved strokes attach insertions; they are not parentheses or mathematical arrows unless recorded as such.

The opening short word visibly starts with q and lacks a preceding ch. The tentative literal que is kept, rather than silently expanding it to chaque. The cancelled strate is replaced above by the two abbreviations comp. conn. The grammatical mismatch que comp. conn. is not corrected.

The condition adjective is intrigante: its deep g descender and terminal t are decisive visual features. Neither the mathematically natural intrinsèque nor H’s entraînant matches those strokes. No mathematical expectation was used to insert the reading.

The two hatted π_1 symbols have angular roof-and-legs forms, as does the π_0 in the component formulas and the π in the margin. On this page the local group/stabilizer/conjugacy context supports lowercase π; angular handwriting by itself is not treated as proof of capital Π. Hats, primes, α and T indices, the Γ subscript bar K/K, and both ends of each displayed or inline arrow were checked individually on the halves or the relevant crop.

The insertion after Donc includes a deletion inside an insertion. Its concluding words are pour tt α, a written abbreviation, not a quantifier sign. The margin likewise retains the abbreviation l’ens, the word discret, the cancelled est, the script E naming the fibre functor, and inserted dist. The note’s fragmentary syntax is preserved without restoring H’s est celui or i.e. par.

The margin’s block E in E=π_0(X prime T) and script E after foncteur-fibre are visually distinct. The noun noyau follows de π, and there is no isolated I. The first composite margin crop cut the extreme upper endpoint of the inserted E formula; one separate tight crop of that still-unresolved endpoint was therefore made and viewed. The neighboring d of main-text d’eux is incidental crossing text, not a symbol inside π_0(...).

The lower corrections preserve the abbreviated revêt, the placement of inserted étale before fini, the abbreviated p. ex, cancelled se représenter, cancelled K- including its hyphen, and rat without a dot. No explicit authorial proof-check statement or question mark occurs on this page. Its cautious framing includes “la” condition intrigante and the parenthetical “p. ex se borner à ce cas”. check_events.statement: For any group action ρ:G→Sym(E), ker(ρ) is the intersection of the stabilizers G_e over all e in E.
check_events.place: Marginal identification of the second member of (55) with the kernel of π→S_E
check_events.outcome: Checked directly in this run: g is in ker(ρ) exactly when ρ(g) is the identity permutation, exactly when it fixes each e, exactly when g belongs to every G_e. This verifies the algebra once the images of the geometric maps are identified with those stabilizers; the geometric identification itself was not independently proved.

check_events.statement: Stabilizers of a transitive group action are conjugate; without transitivity stabilizers from different orbits need not be conjugate.
check_events.place: First parenthetical prose: les images des φ_alpha sont les conjugués
check_events.outcome: Checked: if e=g·e_0 then G_e=gG_e0g^{-1}. For a counterexample without transitivity, C2 acting on a disjoint union of a fixed singleton and a free two-point orbit has stabilizers C2 and {1}, not conjugate. The page does not state connectedness of X prime locally; it may be part of the preceding setup, which was not consulted. The source statement was not rewritten.
